Tests batch URI extraction API (extract_batch)

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract_batch, ExtractInput

async def main() -> None:
    inputs = [ExtractInput(kind="uri", uri="https://example.com/pdf/fake_memo.pdf")]
    result = await extract_batch(inputs)
    print(result.results[0].mime_type)
    print(result.results[0].content)

asyncio.run(main())
```
